2609.27571.title: FDE-Bench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Deployment Environment Configuration
2609.27571.paper_summary: Deployment requires an agent to turn application code into a running system whose services connect, become ready, and remain observable. FDE-Bench evaluates this capability with 136 deployment-configuration tasks spanning Docker images, multi-service Compose stacks, and Kubernetes, in greenfield and diagnose-and-repair modes. Agents submit declarative artifacts that are collected, rebuilt, and redeployed in a pristine environment. Four gated binary check layers measure build, readiness, behavior, and conformance to the deployment specification, using programmatic checks without an LLM judge. A four-arm release gate requires a resolving reference solution and rejects tasks solved by do-nothing, specification-transcription, or generic-stub submissions. The released check annotations expose the link between 2,145 checks and their specifications, including seven documented gaps. Three additional adversarial strategies test shortcuts in the grading signals; none resolves any of the 135 tasks they cover, while a vacuous health probe passes readiness and exposes the need for downstream checks. On the 136-task evaluation grid, seven language models from four providers use the same four-tool scaffold and resolve 52.9-75.0 percent of tasks. The three zero-intelligence floors resolve none and reach a mean Deployment Score of at most 0.44. Readiness is the largest failure stage, accounting for 110 of 313 unresolved episodes. Mean resolution rate is 30.7 percentage points higher on the repair task group than on the disjoint greenfield group, with a positive gap for every model; ten tasks resist all seven. In a 25-task case study, one practicing engineer directing Claude-Sonnet-5 resolves 92 percent against 72 percent for the autonomous baseline. FDE-Bench links deployment success and failure to artifacts that can be inspected and replayed.
2609.27571.paper_summary_zh: 部署需要一個代理將應用程式代碼轉換為一個運行中的系統，其服務連接、變為就緒並保持可觀察性。FDE-Bench 通過 136 個部署配置任務來評估這一能力，涵蓋 Docker 映像、多服務 Compose 堆疊和 Kubernetes，並在綠地和診斷修復模式下進行。代理提交聲明性工件，這些工件在一個乾淨的環境中被收集、重建和重新部署。四個分級二進制檢查層測量構建、就緒、行為和符合部署規範的情況，使用程式性檢查而不依賴 LLM 評判。四臂釋放閘門要求一個解決參考解決方案，並拒絕由無所作為、規範抄錄或通用存根提交解決的任務。釋放的檢查註釋揭示了 2,145 個檢查與其規範之間的聯繫，包括七個記錄的缺口。三種額外的對抗策略測試評分信號中的捷徑；它們涵蓋的 135 個任務中沒有一個能解決，而一個虛無的健康探測通過了就緒性並揭示了對下游檢查的需求。在 136 任務評估網格上，來自四個提供者的七個語言模型使用相同的四工具支架，解決了 52.9-75.0% 的任務。三個零智力基準未解決任何問題，並達到的平均部署分數最多為 0.44。就緒性是最大的失敗階段，佔 313 個未解決事件中的 110 個。修復任務組的平均解決率比不相交的綠地組高出 30.7 個百分點，每個模型都有正向差距；十個任務抵抗所有七個。 在一個 25 任務的案例研究中，一位實踐工程師指導 Claude-Sonnet-5 解決了 92% 的任務，而自主基準為 72%。FDE-Bench 將部署的成功與失敗與可以檢查和重播的工件聯繫起來。
